Mersal is a charitable organization working in the field of health in Egypt. The foundation seeks to reach all eligible patients and provide them with all medical needs
Projects the organization is working on:
Mersal Children's Hospital: Mersal is currently building a children's hospital, and aims to provide medical services to children who are unable.

Oncology Center: seeks to provide treatment for patients of all types of tumors of all age groups. The center provides medical services for cancer treatment, including chemotherapy and periodic follow-up clinics.
Mersal Guest House (endowment of Dr. Ahmed Khaled Tawfiq) The house aims to open a residence for medical cases who are unable to come from outside Cairo and are forced to travel daily for treatment.

A Voice Story Project: The project seeks to help children born with hearing problems by contributing to the costs of cochlear implants or hearing aids. The project includes sponsoring implants for the elderly who have exceeded the age allotted for state support for cochlear implants.
Mersal Emergency Program: The program seeks to provide urgent medical service to patients throughout the week, through Mersal's contracting network with private and government hospitals.

en.q: What is the difference between charity, zakat and current charity?

a.x: Zakat is obligatory for all Muslims, and one of the five pillars of Islam. Every Muslim was required to pay a specific percentage of his money annually for charitable purposes. Charity is completely optional. Unlike zakat, alms are given at any time to any person for any amount or thing, including in-kind alms. Ongoing charity: It is the charity that a person gives in life and continues to benefit from it and others benefit from it until the Day of Judgment, and therefore it is the charity whose reward remains continuous even after the death of the donor.

en.q: How are the recipients of zakat determined?

a.x: How can you make sure that the patient is entitled to your zakat?
A trained professional social researcher, how to conduct a dialogue with the case, conducting research that takes into account Mersal’s standards of privacy and extreme accuracy.
A field researcher observes (the condition of the house and its level, the number of individuals, their education and work, the income with its details and the expenses in order to compare them).

Paperments are required to prove and document the case, such as (salary items, pension statement, land possession, birth certificates, a copy of personal identification and copies of the lease contract).
In order to avoid the inaccuracy of individual judgment, a committee is formed to meet twice a week, consisting of:
Director of Research.
Case Follow-up Manager.
Research Training Director.
Doctor
Pharmacist
The researcher in charge of the case.

The decision is reached by majority after taking into account the social and medical conditions, and the case is registered. The case is classified into (full sponsorship - partial sponsorship - refusal for lack of eligibility or for the availability of free treatment in the state). Get your zakat out while you are assured that it will reach those who deserve it.
